verdict.rationale: ADK publishes a downloadable OpenAPI 3.1 "ADK REST API Reference" for its API server, which exposes agents through a REST API for programmatic use. The Python and TypeScript servers also serve interactive Swagger UI documentation for live requests. Beyond REST, it is a code-first SDK available in Python, TypeScript, Go, Java and Kotlin. Missing for 10: the spec only describes the local dev server (`adk api_server`) rather than a hosted endpoint, the Go server has no /docs, there is no semver or deprecation-window commitment, and there is no independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
